GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package closes audit finding F07. Security decisions remain trustworthy only when their visual identity, input, and provenance cannot be controlled by page or feature code.

Alternatives.Alternative: Let features contribute arbitrary web UI to browser chrome. Rejected because CSS, script, focus, and origin confusion make trusted consent spoofable.
Make all UI fixed in core. Rejected because it prevents the product-level programmability Worldline is intended to provide.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The rendering toolkit and compositor process topology are selected during planning after accessibility and IME spikes.
The full visual design system, wider slot catalog, layout persistence, drag-and-drop, fullscreen, and localization matrix remain later work after the security geometry and one useful slot are proven.

Scenarios.Scenario: A feature contributes a sidebar list and command but the origin and stop controls remain visually and interactively protected.
The feature view crashes while a permission prompt is open; the prompt remains valid or fails closed under trusted shell ownership.
